claims.text: Amangani is high atop East Gros Ventre Butte, overlooking Jackson, Wyoming.

findings.quote: Located high atop East Gros Ventre Butte overlooking Jackson, Wyoming

claims.text: The building was designed by architect Ed Tuttle and is long and slender, with two elongated wings on either side of a central hub.

findings.quote: Designed by late architect Ed Tuttle, the striking building is long and slender, with two elongated wings on either side of a central hub.

claims.text: All suites have gas fireplaces, king-sized beds, deep soaker tubs and plush sitting areas.

findings.quote: All of the suites have gas fireplaces, king-sized beds, deep soaker tubs, and plush sitting areas.

claims.text: The Grill menu features dishes inspired by the Rocky Mountains, such as caribou sausage and elk T-bone steaks.

findings.quote: The menu features dishes inspired by the Rocky Mountains, like caribou sausage and elk T-bone steaks.
